issue.title: [Bug] redact：普通 key/版本号误判为 SECRET，示例密码导致 paperclip 在后续请求持续被替换
issue.body:
## 问题

开启内置 secrets 脱敏后，普通仓库/条目标识和软件版本号会被识别为 `SECRET`。被识别过的值随后还会通过 `known` 在其他独立请求中继续被替换。

`paperclip` 的情况需要区分两步：公开连接串示例里的密码位置被识别为 `PASSWORD` 符合当前规则；但识别以后，普通句子 `Open the paperclip repository.` 中的项目名也会持续被替换。干净进程中的这句话本来不会触发。

这会使发给模型的非秘密项目上下文和版本信息被占位符代替。下面全部使用合成值或公开示例，不含真实凭据及用户聊天内容。

## 环境与版本边界

- 实测源码：[main 的固定快照 da6fd87edeb08bf56e90e1c0fc1cce68a4ce4e9a](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/tree/da6fd87edeb08bf56e90e1c0fc1cce68a4ce4e9a)，提交时间 `2026-10-23T07:45:27Z`。它是开始复现时读到的最新 main，不声称发布本 issue 时的 main HEAD 仍是这个 commit。
- macOS / darwin arm64；Go `1.26.9`。
- 直接调用实际 `internal/redact` 包的 `MaskJSON`，生产源码未修改。
- 配置为 `redact.Options{Secrets: true}`，仅额外设置 `Seen` 收集命中来源；未启用 Personal、本地 PII 模型、自定义词、规则或 allowlist。
- 上游测试的 `TestMain` 隔离用户配置；每个 case 单独启动一个 `go test` 进程，避免不同用例共享 known 状态。

**这里复现的是包函数行为，未运行 GUI、HTTP 网关、模型厂商请求或两个真实客户端会话的端到端链路。**

## 最小复现与实际结果

输入均作为 `messages[0].content` 交给 `MaskJSON`，不是把内层的 `key` 当成顶层协议字段。以下仅把占位符哈希规范化为 `HASH`，类型和 `rule`/`known` 来源来自真实命中。

### 1. 普通记录和版本号被 rule 识别为 SECRET

每一行从全新的测试进程运行：

| 输入 | 实际输出 |
|---|---|
| `{"key":"example-org/demo-project#1234"}` | `{"key":"{{SECRET_HASH}}"}` |
| `{"key":"example1234/demo-repository"}` | `{"key":"{{SECRET_HASH}}"}` |
| `{"versionToken":"2.9.0+sha.a7177d7bb704"}` | `{"versionToken":"{{SECRET_HASH}}"}` |
| `tokenspeed-triton: 3.9.10.post20261008` | `tokenspeed-triton: {{SECRET_HASH}}` |
| `tokenspeed-runner: cu130-torch-2.14.0-flashinfer-0.6.18` | `tokenspeed-runner: {{SECRET_HASH}}` |

以上每项都是 1 次 `rule / SECRET` 命中。

### 2. 公开示例密码使普通项目名在后续请求中命中 known

同一进程内依次调用三次 `MaskJSON`。每次请求都只包含当前消息，没有携带前一条消息历史；`prompt_cache_key` 使用不同的标记值：

```text
请求 B-before：Open the paperclip repository.
输出：Open the paperclip repository.
命中：0

请求 A-seed：postgres://paperclip:paperclip@localhost:5432/paperclip
输出：postgres://paperclip:{{PASSWORD_HASH}}@localhost:5432/paperclip
命中：1，rule / PASSWORD

请求 B-after：Open the paperclip repository.
输出：Open the {{PASSWORD_HASH}} repository.
命中：1，known / PASSWORD
```

仓库标识和版本号也有相同传播：

- `{"source_pr_key":"example-org/demo-project#1234"}` 在干净进程中保持原样；先运行上表的 `key` 输入后，再请求同一段 `source_pr_key` 内容，就会命中 `known / SECRET`。
- `{"buildVersion":"2.9.0+sha.a7177d7bb704"}` 在干净进程中保持原样；先运行 `versionToken` 输入后，再请求同一段 `buildVersion` 内容，就会命中 `known / SECRET`。
- `issue_key` 的干净进程对照也不触发。不能把 `source_pr_key`、`issue_key`、`buildVersion` 全部归为直接规则误报。

## 可直接运行的复现测试

在上述固定 commit 的源码树中，将下面完整文件保存为 `internal/redact/discord_repro_test.go`。函数名沿用已实跑的复现文件。

```sh
# 添加复现文件前，原包基线已执行并通过：
go test -count=1 ./internal/redact

# 添加文件后，每项单独启动一个进程。以下三个代表用例应真实 FAIL：
MAGPIE_REPRO_CASE=repo-key go test -count=1 -run '^TestDiscordRedactionRepro$' -v ./internal/redact
MAGPIE_REPRO_CASE=version-token go test -count=1 -run '^TestDiscordRedactionRepro$' -v ./internal/redact
MAGPIE_REPRO_CASE=paperclip-propagation go test -count=1 -run '^TestDiscordRedactionRepro$' -v ./internal/redact

# 正常凭据保护对照应 PASS：
MAGPIE_REPRO_CASE=api-key-control go test -count=1 -run '^TestDiscordRedactionRepro$' -v ./internal/redact
```

<details>
<summary>完整复现文件：15 个 case，按 MAGPIE_REPRO_CASE 独立运行</summary>

```go
package redact_test

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"regexp"
	"testing"

	"github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/redact"
)

// Run each case in a fresh go test process so known values cannot leak between cases.
func TestDiscordRedactionRepro(t *testing.T) {
	name := os.Getenv("MAGPIE_REPRO_CASE")
	if name == "" {
		t.Fatal("set MAGPIE_REPRO_CASE; see the accompanying verification record")
	}
	normalize := regexp.MustCompile(`\{\{([A-Z_]+)_[a-z2-7]{8}\}\}`)
	mask := func(request, input string) (string, int) {
		t.Helper()
		var hits []map[string]string
		o := redact.Options{Secrets: true, Seen: func(h redact.Hit) {
			hits = append(hits, map[string]string{"kind": h.Kind, "by": h.By})
		}}
		body, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
			"model": "synthetic", "prompt_cache_key": request,
			"messages": []map[string]string{{"role": "user", "content": input}},
		})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		out, n := redact.MaskJSON(body, o)
		var decoded struct {
			Messages []struct{ Content string }
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(out, &decoded); err != nil || len(decoded.Messages) != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("invalid output: %s (%v)", out, err)
		}
		content := decoded.Messages[0].Content
		row, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
			"case": name, "request": request, "input": input, "masked": n,
			"output": normalize.ReplaceAllString(content, "{{${1}_HASH}}"), "hits": hits,
		})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		t.Logf("REPRO %s", row)
		if restored := redact.Restore(string(out), false); restored != string(body) {
			t.Fatalf("round trip changed request: %s", restored)
		}
		return content, n
	}
	unchanged := func(request, input string) {
		t.Helper()
		out, n := mask(request, input)
		if out != input || n != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("non-secret text should remain unchanged; masked=%d", n)
		}
	}
	masked := func(request, input string) {
		t.Helper()
		if _, n := mask(request, input); n == 0 {
			t.Fatal("synthetic credential should be masked")
		}
	}

	cases := map[string]string{
		"repo-key":            `{"key":"example-org/demo-project#1234"}`,
		"repo-name":           `{"key":"example1234/demo-repository"}`,
		"version-token":       `{"versionToken":"2.9.0+sha.a7177d7bb704"}`,
		"tokenspeed-triton":   `tokenspeed-triton: 3.9.10.post20261008`,
		"tokenspeed-runner":   `tokenspeed-runner: cu130-torch-2.14.0-flashinfer-0.6.18`,
		"fresh-source-pr-key": `{"source_pr_key":"example-org/demo-project#1234"}`,
		"fresh-issue-key":     `{"issue_key":"example-org/demo-project#1234"}`,
		"fresh-build-version": `{"buildVersion":"2.9.0+sha.a7177d7bb704"}`,
	}
	if input, ok := cases[name]; ok {
		unchanged("fresh", input)
		return
	}
	switch name {
	case "repo-propagation":
		input := `{"source_pr_key":"example-org/demo-project#1234"}`
		unchanged("conversation-b-before", input)
		mask("conversation-a-seed", cases["repo-key"])
		unchanged("conversation-b-after", input)
	case "version-propagation":
		input := cases["fresh-build-version"]
		unchanged("conversation-b-before", input)
		mask("conversation-a-seed", cases["version-token"])
		unchanged("conversation-b-after", input)
	case "paperclip-propagation":
		const input = "Open the paperclip repository."
		unchanged("conversation-b-before", input)
		masked("conversation-a-seed", "postgres://paperclip:paperclip@localhost:5432/paperclip")
		unchanged("conversation-b-after", input)
	case "api-key-control":
		masked("control", `{"api_key":"sk-proj-SYNTHETICONLY0123456789abcdef"}`)
	case "generic-key-control":
		masked("control", `{"key":"NotARealCredential1234567890abcdef"}`)
	case "db-password-control":
		masked("control", "postgres://demo:SyntheticOnlyPass123@127.0.0.1/demo")
	case "short-password-control":
		masked("seed", "postgres://demo:pass@127.0.0.1/demo")
		unchanged("after", "The tests pass.")
	default:
		t.Fatal("unknown case: " + name)
	}
}
```

</details>

## 预期行为与已完成验证

希望非秘密的项目标识、版本号和普通项目名保留原文，同时继续保护真实凭据；尤其希望避免一次误识别使后续无关请求持续受影响。不是建议关闭整个 known 机制，也不是建议把 `paperclip` 在所有上下文中一概放行。

已实际执行：

- 加入复现文件前，原有 `internal/redact` 包退出码为 0，记录了 58 个测试 PASS 事件，无 FAIL/SKIP。
- 15 个 case 分别在独立进程中执行：5 项直接规则误报和 3 项 known 传播序列的“非秘密文本应保持不变”断言失败；其余 7 项对照通过。这些 FAIL 是问题复现，不是编译失败。
- 7 项对照为：干净进程的 `source_pr_key`、`issue_key`、`buildVersion`；合成 API key、普通 key 字段中的合成凭据、合成 URL 密码；短示例密码 `pass` 不会扩散到普通句子 `The tests pass.`。
- 每一步都验证了 `Restore` 能还原原始 JSON；这里未观察到 JSON 还原失败。

## 源码线索与相关反馈

固定版本的 [redact.go](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/da6fd87edeb08bf56e90e1c0fc1cce68a4ce4e9a/internal/redact/redact.go) 中，裸 `key` 的宽泛值规则及字段名中的 `token` 子串匹配能够触发上述样本；[known.go](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/da6fd87edeb08bf56e90e1c0fc1cce68a4ce4e9a/internal/redact/known.go) 会在进程内记住长度至少 8 的值，并在后续请求中按同值及边界匹配。尚未实现修复，希望协助确认规则及 known 的置信度/上下文边界。

相关但不同的反馈：[文件名被识别为 EMAIL](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/issues/3029)、[PII 模型误判协议字段为 PERSON](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/issues/3144)。本报告不依赖本地 PII 模型，只启用内置 secrets 检测，并在消息正文里复现。

AI 辅助披露：Codex 协助调查、编写复现及整理本报告。上述命令已实际执行；没有生产修复，也没有把未运行的 GUI/网关端到端验证写成已通过。

## 2026-10-24 更正与更新

原始交付 `4b6d93d9` 已被后续返工替代。原文“secret 里不会有 `x.y.z`”的判断不成立：真实凭据完全可能含点分数字或 `/`，不能单凭值的形状放行。

当前交付：[`r3-batch`](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/r3-batch)，固定 head [`7f927133be68a452f662d0c7445a1432e66c426a`](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/7f927133be68a452f662d0c7445a1432e66c426a)，base `b437e4adb4dba82446e0d625b040a8e2d95004b4`。这是完整验证树；本题的最终规则补强提交是 [`c7acc938`](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/c7acc938fea62da2fcfc90db722103e68169559e)，它依赖前面的本题实现，不能单独代表整个修复。

修正后的行为：

- **版本/仓库例外结合字段语义判断。** `password`、`api_key`、`api-key`、紧凑/后缀写法及 `token_signing_key`、`token_encryption_key` 等明确凭据名，不会再因值形似 `owner/repo` 或含 `1.2.3` 而进入这些例外。报告中的 `versionToken`、`tokenspeed-*` 和裸 `key` 下的良性版本/仓库样例继续保留原文。
- **不学习是可升级且能重建的状态。** 一个值仅在 `postgres://v:v@…` 的密码槽出现时原位遮蔽、不会传播到普通文本；随后若在 `postgres://realuser:v@…` 中成为真实密码，就升级为已知凭据。`reindexKnown` 只重建已学习的值，未学习的占位值不会因重建而污染后续请求；恢复映射仍保留。
- **保留上游已发送文本的缓存规则。** 升级/重建测试使用此前未处理过的新文本，避免同文缓存掩盖问题；`TestSentTextKeepsItsMasking` 和 `TestMaskedConversationKeepsItsCachedPrefix` 的语义保留。

交付中的回归覆盖包括原始良性样例、最初三个凭据反例、24 项 Mask/MaskJSON 路径矩阵、8 项紧凑/后缀名称、6 项 token-key 组合名称，以及学习升级、真实重建和缓存控制组。最终树的全量日志记录 `internal/redact` 为通过（缓存命中）；[验证记录](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/blob/c1e0d235ed309438795fc07c86d7d04c3132c44b/docs/fork/evidence/round7/manifest.json) 同时保留全量 nogui 的 **66 包 ok / 3 包 FAIL / 19 no-test，exit 1**，失败对应既有 #3280/#2207/#3284，未宣称全套全绿。

本题相关变更按顺序为 `a4dcc55d → 23973fd9 → 8fb84119 → a0b2faa8 → bbd6e228 → c7acc938`；完整 SHA 与分支历史见 [fork 台账](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/blob/c1e0d235ed309438795fc07c86d7d04c3132c44b/docs/fork/upstream-status.json)。这是一份相关变更索引，没有另行验证这些提交脱离 batch 后的选择性 cherry-pick。

实现及审查使用了 AI 辅助。验证限于本地实现、隔离夹具与测试，没有调用真实供应商或驱动 GUI。下面保留原文作为已被替代的历史。

---

<details>
<summary>原始交付说明（已被以上更正替代，仅供追溯）</summary>

已在 fork 里修好（三个过判，三处窄修）：

- commit：https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/4b6d93d9（分支 [`fix/issue-batch-1023pm`](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/issue-batch-1023pm)，基于当前 main，即你快照 da6fd87e 之后的 main）

## 1. URL 占位密码不再进 known（第 2 节的传播）

你的判断我照单采纳：`postgres://paperclip:paperclip@…` 的密码位置被 PASSWORD 规则识别是**符合当前规则的**，问题在识别之后值被 `addKnown` 学走。现在：密码 == 同一 URL 的用户名（占位连接串的经典形状）时，仍然原位打码，但**不进 known**——plain sentence 里的项目名不再被换掉。真实密码（不等于用户名）照旧学习、照旧在后续请求中被换回占位符；Restore 不受影响，只有 known 匹配被拦。

- 红→绿：`TestURLPasswordEqualToItsUserIsNotLearned` 按你的三请求序列（B-before / A-seed / B-after）写成，关掉 learn 判定后真实 FAIL（`"Open the {{PASSWORD_…}} repository."`），并带一个真实密码控制组（仍学习）。实现走 span 加 `learn=false`：placeholder/put 链路加了一个 learn 参数。

## 2. 版本号不再是 SECRET（第 1 节的 rule 误报）

`secretValue`（token/key 赋值类规则共用的 ok 谓词）拒绝**含三段点分数字**的值：`2.9.0+sha.a7177d7bb704`、`3.9.10.post20261008`、`cu130-torch-2.14.0-flashinfer-0.6.18` 全部放过。secret 里不会有 `x.y.z` 连跑。

## 3. 仓库路径/引用不再是 SECRET

`owner/name` 与 `owner/name#123`（值内再无别的字符）同样被 `secretValue` 拒绝：`example-org/demo-project#1234`、`example1234/demo-repository` 放过。

- 红→绿：`TestVersionIsNotASecret` / `TestRepoRefIsNotASecret` 用你表中的每个输入 + 一个真 key 值控制组（`oc_sk_…` 仍打码）；各自关掉守卫后真实 FAIL。

`internal/redact` 全包（63 个测试）通过；gofmt 干净；`go vet` 通过。没有动 PASSWORD 规则本身的识别范围（你说识别本身是对的），也没有动 known 的既有学习行为——只有占位形状这一处被拦。

</details>

补充一个实际使用中的同类现象：普通英文字符串 `verifier` 本身也被脱敏了，`verifier-node` 中的同一部分也会被替换。

在 Magpie「请求内容 → 对照」界面中，可以看到以下差异（仅摘录与问题有关的短语，占位符哈希统一写作 `<hash>`）：

| 这台电脑上的原文 | 厂商看到的样子 |
| --- | --- |
| `verifier nodes` | `{{PASSWORD_<hash>}} nodes` |
| `verifier-node tagged droplets` | `{{PASSWORD_<hash>}}-node tagged droplets` |

对应位置分别为 `assistant messages[2].content[0].thinking` 和 `assistant messages[14].content[0].thinking`。这两处是在普通叙述中指代节点/服务名称，并不是密码赋值或凭据内容。

预期这类普通词和节点名称保留原文，避免模型看到的上下文被密码占位符替代。希望排查本 issue 时也覆盖这个样本。

本补充根据请求内容对照截图整理；尚未确认最初触发识别的位置，也未确认本例是直接规则误判还是 `known` 传播。

补充样本收到。用探针在当前 main（`19253f67`，redact 包）上把两条可能的来源分开验证了一下，结论：**裸词 `verifier` 本身不会触发规则**，这个样本几乎可以确定是 `known` 传播——与本 issue 主题"示例密码被学习后在后续内容持续被替换"是同一家族。

探针（`internal/redact`，`MaskJSON` 真实引擎，thinking 内容带/不带 `signature` 各测一轮）：

| 前置状态 | `verifier nodes` / `verifier-node tagged droplets` 的结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 无任何前置（未学习） | 原样保留，0 次命中，无任何 `ByRule` |
| 前置 `Preview`/`Scrub` 过包含 verifier 的 URL（不学习） | 原样保留 |
| 前置 `Mask` 过 `postgres://service:verifier@localhost/db`（URL 密码位学到） | 整词替换为 `{{PASSWORD_<hash>}}`，`-node` 中的部分同样替换，`By=ByKnown` |
| 前置 `Mask` 过 `密码：verifier`（赋值右侧学到） | 同上，整词替换 |

也就是说，与你截图完全一致的替换形态，只在同一请求上下文里**更早出现过一次把 `verifier` 当作凭据值**（URL 的密码位、或 password/token/secret 类赋值的右侧，包括代码块里的示例凭据）时发生；学到之后所有出现处都会被替换——含 `verifier-node` 里的部分匹配——这正是当前"已知值全程遮蔽"的设计路径，不是新的规则误判。

两个可以帮忙收口的点：

1. 方便的话在这台电脑的同一条请求里（「对照」界面向前翻，或直接搜原始 JSON）确认是否存在 `:verifier@`、`密码/token/secret…: verifier` 这类更早的出现。有的话，本例即已知的传播行为，是否要限制"学到的值在叙述性文本中的传播"（比如只遮蔽凭据位、或对短词/常见词不传播）是维护者的取舍：真实密码完全可能恰好是个普通英文词，收紧传播就有漏遮的真实风险。
2. 如果确认**没有**任何更早的凭据位出现，那才是新的规则误判路径——那种情况下请把该条请求的原始 JSON（脱敏后）贴出来，我们按原样复现。

探针代码与完整日志：[verifier_test.go / probe.log](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/dev/docs/fork/evidence/round23/3365-verifier-probe)（dev 分支证据目录）。

感谢排查，确认了：同一段上下文里更早确实出现过

```
postgresql://verifier:verifier@127.0.0.1:5432/verifier
```

这是本地测试库的连接串，用户名、密码、库名都是 `verifier`。所以本例是 `known` 传播，不是新的规则误判，和 `paperclip` 是同一种形状（密码 == 用户名）。

我看了一下，`r3-batch` 的 `redact.go` 对“URL 密码等于用户名”会标记 `nolearn`，这个样本应该也能被覆盖：只在原位遮蔽，不再传播到 `verifier nodes` 这类叙述文本。上游 main（`5e3dd1d5`）目前还没有这段逻辑。

另外想补充一个产品层面的建议。我现在是把 `verifier` 加进「从不脱敏」解决的。但刚遇到时完全摸不着头脑：对照界面只显示 `{{PASSWORD_<hash>}}`，看不出是规则命中还是 `known` 命中，更不知道它是从哪里学来的。普通用户并不知道有 `known` 这层机制。

同意你说的，收紧传播有漏遮真实密码的风险。所以比起改默认策略，我更希望让用户能看见、能管理：

1. **对照界面标出命中来源**：区分 rule / known；如果是 known，最好能指出它最初是在哪条请求、哪个位置学到的。
2. **提供 known 列表**：让用户看到当前学到了哪些值（可以只显示部分字符）。
3. **列表条目可以直接加白名单，并和现有的「从不脱敏」合并成同一个设置**，不要再多一套概念。在列表里点一下“不再脱敏”，就等于写进「从不脱敏」。

这样默认的保护强度不变，误伤时用户也能自己找到原因、自己解决，不用靠猜。

两个点都对，补一下现状，免得重复造轮子：

**“对照界面标出命中来源”这条，当前 main 已经有了**，只是不在字面上：请求记录里每个占位符悬停/聚焦时的提示会写 `种类 · 谁发现的`（`maskByName`，`MASK_BY` 五个值：Rules / Your rules / Your words / Local model / **Seen before**），`maskrec.Value.By`（JSON 的 `b`）逐值记录，`known` 就是 `known` 传播。`/api/masking/records?by=known` 也能按来源过滤记录。所以“看不出是规则命中还是 known 命中”这一半，升级到最新版就有了（悬停才显示，这一点确实不明显——你的建议里“标出来”如果指的是不悬停就可见，那是个 UI 改动，属于 yetone 的取舍）。

**“它最初是在哪条请求学到的”这条，目前确实没有**：`known` 的存储只有 值→占位符 的映射（内存里，重启即清），不记来源。最近的近似是记录列表——同一占位符第一条 `By != known` 的记录基本就是它被学进去的那次，但没有任何链接或跳转把它连起来。

**known 列表和一键加白**也都没有：allowlist（从不脱敏）是 `RedactAllow`，独立于 known，两者之间没有通道。要把“点一下不再脱敏 = 写进从不脱敏”做起来，得先有 known 列表，这在产品上是 yetone 的决定——默认保护强度不动、误伤可解释可解决，这个方向我同意。

**`nolearn` 那半仍然只在 fork 上**，你说得对：`upstream/main`（`3a89dd53`）的 redact 没有“URL 密码等于其用户”的豁免，`r3-batch`（`7f927133`）里的那段还没进主干。也就是说在 main 上，`postgresql://verifier:verifier@…` 这类值第一次经过时仍会被学习并替换后文——和 `paperclip` 同一个坑。你确认的这个样本正好把它钉住了；要不要把这一小块单独重放（不带 r3-batch 其余的返工）到当前 main，我可以在你点头后做。

## Additional observation: a common technical word is propagated as a password

On a Windows installation, I found a masking-log placeholder that matches the ordinary word `password` when checked locally against Magpie's keyed placeholder calculation. Across the available records from 2026-10-29 through 2026-11-01 (UTC+8), it appears in **4,888 request records**: 328 labelled `rule` and 4,560 labelled `known`, with 29,179 recorded replacement positions.

These are masking counts, **not a count of false positives**: requests can repeat conversation history, and the saved logs do not retain enough original context to classify each occurrence or identify the initial seed. The locally installed version at investigation time was 0.1.2587; the log records do not identify the app version for each historical request.

I reproduced the problematic use of this word in a fresh process using the **v0.1.2587** source (commit `6dc94f57aae8c8822fe8e4b6ba887232ecb9c68a`), Linux, Go 1.26.10, and `Secrets: true`:

1. `Inspect SSH password authentication first.` stays unchanged.
2. A synthetic connection string, `postgresql://example:password@localhost/test`, is correctly masked as `rule / PASSWORD`.
3. A different piece of ordinary prose, `Review SSH password authentication now.`, is then sent as `Review SSH {{PASSWORD_<hash>}} authentication now.` with `known / PASSWORD`.

This confirms the same propagation behavior discussed in this issue can also replace a common word used to describe authentication. The synthetic test does not establish which historical log occurrence first taught the value, and it calls `redact.Mask` directly rather than exercising the GUI or gateway. The desired outcome is to preserve ordinary context while continuing to protect actual credentials.

<details>
<summary>Reproduction test</summary>

Save as `internal/redact/masking_log_repro_test.go`, then run `go test -tags nogui ./internal/redact -run '^TestMaskingLogCommonNoun$' -count=1 -v`. The test below passed against the tagged source.

```go
package redact

import (
    "strings"
    "testing"
)

func TestMaskingLogCommonNoun(t *testing.T) {
    word := "pass" + "word"
    var hits []Hit
    o := Options{Secrets: true, Seen: func(h Hit) { hits = append(hits, h) }}
    before := "Inspect SSH " + word + " authentication first."
    if out, n := Mask(before, o); out != before || n != 0 {
        t.Fatalf("fresh prose changed: hits=%d", n)
    }

    hits = nil
    seed := "postgresql://example:" + word + "@localhost/test"
    seedOut, n := Mask(seed, o)
    if n != 1 || len(hits) != 1 || hits[0].Kind != "PASSWORD" || hits[0].By != ByRule {
        t.Fatalf("synthetic credential seed did not produce a rule/password hit: n=%d hits=%v", n, hits)
    }
    if seedOut != strings.Replace(seed, word, hits[0].Placeholder, 1) {
        t.Fatal("unexpected seed output")
    }

    hits = nil
    after := "Review SSH " + word + " authentication now."
    out, n := Mask(after, o)
    if n != 1 || len(hits) != 1 || hits[0].Kind != "PASSWORD" || hits[0].By != ByKnown {
        t.Fatalf("expected known/password in fresh prose: n=%d hits=%v", n, hits)
    }
    if out != strings.Replace(after, word, hits[0].Placeholder, 1) {
        t.Fatal("unexpected prose output")
    }
}
```

</details>

Codex assisted with the log analysis and reproduction.

**Observation during this investigation:** On 2026-11-02, the first locally observed `rule` record for the existing public example word `verifier` appeared about two seconds after a tool returned this issue's comments into the analysis chat. The same keyed value was subsequently recorded as `known` in two other sessions. The persisted log does not establish the original seed or the surrounding text in those other sessions, so this is a sequence consistent with cross-session propagation, not proof of the exact content affected. These records arose during this investigation and are not independent historical reports.

**Additional historical candidates.** Before this investigation started, the logs also recorded the following values as `SECRET`. I matched each value locally against its keyed placeholder. These strings have ordinary technical uses, but the saved records do not include the text around each match, so these are suspected false positives rather than individually verified instances. A string could also be used as an actual secret in a different context.

| Matched value | Request records | Recorded finder label | Ordinary use |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- |
| `CreateProcessAsUserW` | `894` | `3 rule; 891 known` | `Windows API function name` |
| `WindowStyle Hidden` | `642` | `642 known` | `PowerShell option text` |
| `maxAgeDays` | `288` | `49 model; 239 known` | `configuration-style identifier` |
| `pbkdf2-sha256` | `12` | `12 rule` | `algorithm name` |

The snapshot ends at 2026-11-02 16:52 UTC+8, before this investigation; these counts can include repeated conversation history. A request's label is the log's merged label for that value, not necessarily the finder for every position in the request.

comments.body:
Thank you for the measurement and the clean reproduction — the counts (4,888 request records, 4,560 of them labelled `known`, 29,179 recorded positions) and the three-step repro name the defect exactly, and your caution that they are masking counts rather than verified false positives is the right way to read them.

**The class.** This is the known-value learning (known.go), the same family as `paperclip`/`verifier`, but a different face of it. Those two were a URL password that equals its user name; `hiddenInURL` on current main already leaves those as written. Your case is the other shape a placeholder connection string has: the password is not the user name, so the URL's password slot is masked at mask time — correctly — and then `addKnown` learned the value. The value was the bare word `password`: the credential's own name, the word every example credential is given (`postgresql://example:password@localhost/test`, `DB_PASSWORD=password`). Once learned, every ordinary sentence that uses the word went as `{{PASSWORD_<hash>}}`, which is what your 4,560 `known` records show. I reproduced it on the current main source exactly as your test does.

**The fix** (branch [`fix/3365-known-common-words`](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/3365-known-common-words), head `ad4ee842cfc17a814b6c3f3810437d8172a2842c`, based on today's main): such a word is not learned. `addKnown` turns away a value in a small closed list — `password`, `passphrase`, `username`, `credential`, `credentials` — words that name a credential and appear as stand-in values in example credentials. Everything else is unchanged:

- The URL's own mask still happens on the first request: `postgresql://example:password@localhost/test` masks the userinfo password exactly as before, `rule / PASSWORD`. Only the spreading as `known` stops, so `Review SSH password authentication now.` stays as written afterwards.
- Restore is untouched: the value is held by its placeholder either way.
- Learning still works for real credentials: a password with a digit, symbol or capital in it (`Tr0ub4dor3`) is learned from the same URL slot and re-masked in later prose as before.

**The boundary, stated plainly.** The list is closed and every entry is lowercase letters alone, so deliberately:

- A bare common word *outside* the list still learns — `strawberry` from `postgresql://example:strawberry@…` still replaces later text. `opensesame` already had a test holding that behavior (`TestURLPasswordStillMasked`), and a real password can be any word: a broader dictionary of ordinary words is a real trade-off (it would stop propagating genuine one-word passwords), so I did not make that choice unilaterally. If a dictionary guard is preferred, this is the single place to widen.
- Mixed case (`Password`) and anything with a digit or symbol still learn.
- Your historical candidates table mostly sits outside this guard by shape: `CreateProcessAsUserW` and `maxAgeDays` are mixed case, `WindowStyle Hidden` has a space, `pbkdf2-sha256` has digits and a hyphen. They are the wider question of what the model/rules should learn from technical prose, not this face.

Tests: `TestCredentialOwnNameNotLearned` (adapted from your repro) — URL masks once, later prose and `DB_PASSWORD=password` stay as written, real-password control still re-masks, `strawberry` and `Password` still learn. Red on main with only the `addKnown` check removed; full `internal/redact` package passes (nogui and default tags), gofmt clean, `go vet` clean.

timeline.body:
## 2026-10-24 更正与更新

原始交付 `4b6d93d9` 已被后续返工替代。原文“secret 里不会有 `x.y.z`”的判断不成立：真实凭据完全可能含点分数字或 `/`，不能单凭值的形状放行。

当前交付：[`r3-batch`](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/r3-batch)，固定 head [`7f927133be68a452f662d0c7445a1432e66c426a`](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/7f927133be68a452f662d0c7445a1432e66c426a)，base `b437e4adb4dba82446e0d625b040a8e2d95004b4`。这是完整验证树；本题的最终规则补强提交是 [`c7acc938`](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/c7acc938fea62da2fcfc90db722103e68169559e)，它依赖前面的本题实现，不能单独代表整个修复。

修正后的行为：

- **版本/仓库例外结合字段语义判断。** `password`、`api_key`、`api-key`、紧凑/后缀写法及 `token_signing_key`、`token_encryption_key` 等明确凭据名，不会再因值形似 `owner/repo` 或含 `1.2.3` 而进入这些例外。报告中的 `versionToken`、`tokenspeed-*` 和裸 `key` 下的良性版本/仓库样例继续保留原文。
- **不学习是可升级且能重建的状态。** 一个值仅在 `postgres://v:v@…` 的密码槽出现时原位遮蔽、不会传播到普通文本；随后若在 `postgres://realuser:v@…` 中成为真实密码，就升级为已知凭据。`reindexKnown` 只重建已学习的值，未学习的占位值不会因重建而污染后续请求；恢复映射仍保留。
- **保留上游已发送文本的缓存规则。** 升级/重建测试使用此前未处理过的新文本，避免同文缓存掩盖问题；`TestSentTextKeepsItsMasking` 和 `TestMaskedConversationKeepsItsCachedPrefix` 的语义保留。

交付中的回归覆盖包括原始良性样例、最初三个凭据反例、24 项 Mask/MaskJSON 路径矩阵、8 项紧凑/后缀名称、6 项 token-key 组合名称，以及学习升级、真实重建和缓存控制组。最终树的全量日志记录 `internal/redact` 为通过（缓存命中）；[验证记录](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/blob/c1e0d235ed309438795fc07c86d7d04c3132c44b/docs/fork/evidence/round7/manifest.json) 同时保留全量 nogui 的 **66 包 ok / 3 包 FAIL / 19 no-test，exit 1**，失败对应既有 #3280/#2207/#3284，未宣称全套全绿。

本题相关变更按顺序为 `a4dcc55d → 23973fd9 → 8fb84119 → a0b2faa8 → bbd6e228 → c7acc938`；完整 SHA 与分支历史见 [fork 台账](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/blob/c1e0d235ed309438795fc07c86d7d04c3132c44b/docs/fork/upstream-status.json)。这是一份相关变更索引，没有另行验证这些提交脱离 batch 后的选择性 cherry-pick。

实现及审查使用了 AI 辅助。验证限于本地实现、隔离夹具与测试，没有调用真实供应商或驱动 GUI。下面保留原文作为已被替代的历史。

---

<details>
<summary>原始交付说明（已被以上更正替代，仅供追溯）</summary>

已在 fork 里修好（三个过判，三处窄修）：

- commit：https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/4b6d93d9（分支 [`fix/issue-batch-1023pm`](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/issue-batch-1023pm)，基于当前 main，即你快照 da6fd87e 之后的 main）

## 1. URL 占位密码不再进 known（第 2 节的传播）

你的判断我照单采纳：`postgres://paperclip:paperclip@…` 的密码位置被 PASSWORD 规则识别是**符合当前规则的**，问题在识别之后值被 `addKnown` 学走。现在：密码 == 同一 URL 的用户名（占位连接串的经典形状）时，仍然原位打码，但**不进 known**——plain sentence 里的项目名不再被换掉。真实密码（不等于用户名）照旧学习、照旧在后续请求中被换回占位符；Restore 不受影响，只有 known 匹配被拦。

- 红→绿：`TestURLPasswordEqualToItsUserIsNotLearned` 按你的三请求序列（B-before / A-seed / B-after）写成，关掉 learn 判定后真实 FAIL（`"Open the {{PASSWORD_…}} repository."`），并带一个真实密码控制组（仍学习）。实现走 span 加 `learn=false`：placeholder/put 链路加了一个 learn 参数。

## 2. 版本号不再是 SECRET（第 1 节的 rule 误报）

`secretValue`（token/key 赋值类规则共用的 ok 谓词）拒绝**含三段点分数字**的值：`2.9.0+sha.a7177d7bb704`、`3.9.10.post20261008`、`cu130-torch-2.14.0-flashinfer-0.6.18` 全部放过。secret 里不会有 `x.y.z` 连跑。

## 3. 仓库路径/引用不再是 SECRET

`owner/name` 与 `owner/name#123`（值内再无别的字符）同样被 `secretValue` 拒绝：`example-org/demo-project#1234`、`example1234/demo-repository` 放过。

- 红→绿：`TestVersionIsNotASecret` / `TestRepoRefIsNotASecret` 用你表中的每个输入 + 一个真 key 值控制组（`oc_sk_…` 仍打码）；各自关掉守卫后真实 FAIL。

`internal/redact` 全包（63 个测试）通过；gofmt 干净；`go vet` 通过。没有动 PASSWORD 规则本身的识别范围（你说识别本身是对的），也没有动 known 的既有学习行为——只有占位形状这一处被拦。

</details>

补充一个实际使用中的同类现象：普通英文字符串 `verifier` 本身也被脱敏了，`verifier-node` 中的同一部分也会被替换。

在 Magpie「请求内容 → 对照」界面中，可以看到以下差异（仅摘录与问题有关的短语，占位符哈希统一写作 `<hash>`）：

| 这台电脑上的原文 | 厂商看到的样子 |
| --- | --- |
| `verifier nodes` | `{{PASSWORD_<hash>}} nodes` |
| `verifier-node tagged droplets` | `{{PASSWORD_<hash>}}-node tagged droplets` |

对应位置分别为 `assistant messages[2].content[0].thinking` 和 `assistant messages[14].content[0].thinking`。这两处是在普通叙述中指代节点/服务名称，并不是密码赋值或凭据内容。

预期这类普通词和节点名称保留原文，避免模型看到的上下文被密码占位符替代。希望排查本 issue 时也覆盖这个样本。

本补充根据请求内容对照截图整理；尚未确认最初触发识别的位置，也未确认本例是直接规则误判还是 `known` 传播。

| 前置 `Mask` 过 `postgres://service:verifier@localhost/db`（URL 密码位学到） | 整词替换为 `{{PASSWORD_<hash>}}`，`-node` 中的部分同样替换，`By=ByKnown` |
| 前置 `Mask` 过 `密码：verifier`（赋值右侧学到） | 同上，整词替换 |

也就是说，与你截图完全一致的替换形态，只在同一请求上下文里**更早出现过一次把 `verifier` 当作凭据值**（URL 的密码位、或 password/token/secret 类赋值的右侧，包括代码块里的示例凭据）时发生；学到之后所有出现处都会被替换——含 `verifier-node` 里的部分匹配——这正是当前"已知值全程遮蔽"的设计路径，不是新的规则误判。

两个可以帮忙收口的点：

1. 方便的话在这台电脑的同一条请求里（「对照」界面向前翻，或直接搜原始 JSON）确认是否存在 `:verifier@`、`密码/token/secret…: verifier` 这类更早的出现。有的话，本例即已知的传播行为，是否要限制"学到的值在叙述性文本中的传播"（比如只遮蔽凭据位、或对短词/常见词不传播）是维护者的取舍：真实密码完全可能恰好是个普通英文词，收紧传播就有漏遮的真实风险。
2. 如果确认**没有**任何更早的凭据位出现，那才是新的规则误判路径——那种情况下请把该条请求的原始 JSON（脱敏后）贴出来，我们按原样复现。

探针代码与完整日志：[verifier_test.go / probe.log](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/dev/docs/fork/evidence/round23/3365-verifier-probe)（dev 分支证据目录）。

感谢排查，确认了：同一段上下文里更早确实出现过

```
postgresql://verifier:verifier@127.0.0.1:5432/verifier
```

这是本地测试库的连接串，用户名、密码、库名都是 `verifier`。所以本例是 `known` 传播，不是新的规则误判，和 `paperclip` 是同一种形状（密码 == 用户名）。

我看了一下，`r3-batch` 的 `redact.go` 对“URL 密码等于用户名”会标记 `nolearn`，这个样本应该也能被覆盖：只在原位遮蔽，不再传播到 `verifier nodes` 这类叙述文本。上游 main（`5e3dd1d5`）目前还没有这段逻辑。

另外想补充一个产品层面的建议。我现在是把 `verifier` 加进「从不脱敏」解决的。但刚遇到时完全摸不着头脑：对照界面只显示 `{{PASSWORD_<hash>}}`，看不出是规则命中还是 `known` 命中，更不知道它是从哪里学来的。普通用户并不知道有 `known` 这层机制。

同意你说的，收紧传播有漏遮真实密码的风险。所以比起改默认策略，我更希望让用户能看见、能管理：

1. **对照界面标出命中来源**：区分 rule / known；如果是 known，最好能指出它最初是在哪条请求、哪个位置学到的。
2. **提供 known 列表**：让用户看到当前学到了哪些值（可以只显示部分字符）。
3. **列表条目可以直接加白名单，并和现有的「从不脱敏」合并成同一个设置**，不要再多一套概念。在列表里点一下“不再脱敏”，就等于写进「从不脱敏」。

这样默认的保护强度不变，误伤时用户也能自己找到原因、自己解决，不用靠猜。

两个点都对，补一下现状，免得重复造轮子：

**“对照界面标出命中来源”这条，当前 main 已经有了**，只是不在字面上：请求记录里每个占位符悬停/聚焦时的提示会写 `种类 · 谁发现的`（`maskByName`，`MASK_BY` 五个值：Rules / Your rules / Your words / Local model / **Seen before**），`maskrec.Value.By`（JSON 的 `b`）逐值记录，`known` 就是 `known` 传播。`/api/masking/records?by=known` 也能按来源过滤记录。所以“看不出是规则命中还是 known 命中”这一半，升级到最新版就有了（悬停才显示，这一点确实不明显——你的建议里“标出来”如果指的是不悬停就可见，那是个 UI 改动，属于 yetone 的取舍）。

**“它最初是在哪条请求学到的”这条，目前确实没有**：`known` 的存储只有 值→占位符 的映射（内存里，重启即清），不记来源。最近的近似是记录列表——同一占位符第一条 `By != known` 的记录基本就是它被学进去的那次，但没有任何链接或跳转把它连起来。

**known 列表和一键加白**也都没有：allowlist（从不脱敏）是 `RedactAllow`，独立于 known，两者之间没有通道。要把“点一下不再脱敏 = 写进从不脱敏”做起来，得先有 known 列表，这在产品上是 yetone 的决定——默认保护强度不动、误伤可解释可解决，这个方向我同意。

**`nolearn` 那半仍然只在 fork 上**，你说得对：`upstream/main`（`3a89dd53`）的 redact 没有“URL 密码等于其用户”的豁免，`r3-batch`（`7f927133`）里的那段还没进主干。也就是说在 main 上，`postgresql://verifier:verifier@…` 这类值第一次经过时仍会被学习并替换后文——和 `paperclip` 同一个坑。你确认的这个样本正好把它钉住了；要不要把这一小块单独重放（不带 r3-batch 其余的返工）到当前 main，我可以在你点头后做。

## Additional observation: a common technical word is propagated as a password

On a Windows installation, I found a masking-log placeholder that matches the ordinary word `password` when checked locally against Magpie's keyed placeholder calculation. Across the available records from 2026-10-29 through 2026-11-01 (UTC+8), it appears in **4,888 request records**: 328 labelled `rule` and 4,560 labelled `known`, with 29,179 recorded replacement positions.

These are masking counts, **not a count of false positives**: requests can repeat conversation history, and the saved logs do not retain enough original context to classify each occurrence or identify the initial seed. The locally installed version at investigation time was 0.1.2587; the log records do not identify the app version for each historical request.

I reproduced the problematic use of this word in a fresh process using the **v0.1.2587** source (commit `6dc94f57aae8c8822fe8e4b6ba887232ecb9c68a`), Linux, Go 1.26.10, and `Secrets: true`:

1. `Inspect SSH password authentication first.` stays unchanged.
2. A synthetic connection string, `postgresql://example:password@localhost/test`, is correctly masked as `rule / PASSWORD`.
3. A different piece of ordinary prose, `Review SSH password authentication now.`, is then sent as `Review SSH {{PASSWORD_<hash>}} authentication now.` with `known / PASSWORD`.

This confirms the same propagation behavior discussed in this issue can also replace a common word used to describe authentication. The synthetic test does not establish which historical log occurrence first taught the value, and it calls `redact.Mask` directly rather than exercising the GUI or gateway. The desired outcome is to preserve ordinary context while continuing to protect actual credentials.

<details>
<summary>Reproduction test</summary>

Save as `internal/redact/masking_log_repro_test.go`, then run `go test -tags nogui ./internal/redact -run '^TestMaskingLogCommonNoun$' -count=1 -v`. The test below passed against the tagged source.

```go
package redact

import (
    "strings"
    "testing"
)

func TestMaskingLogCommonNoun(t *testing.T) {
    word := "pass" + "word"
    var hits []Hit
    o := Options{Secrets: true, Seen: func(h Hit) { hits = append(hits, h) }}
    before := "Inspect SSH " + word + " authentication first."
    if out, n := Mask(before, o); out != before || n != 0 {
        t.Fatalf("fresh prose changed: hits=%d", n)
    }

    hits = nil
    seed := "postgresql://example:" + word + "@localhost/test"
    seedOut, n := Mask(seed, o)
    if n != 1 || len(hits) != 1 || hits[0].Kind != "PASSWORD" || hits[0].By != ByRule {
        t.Fatalf("synthetic credential seed did not produce a rule/password hit: n=%d hits=%v", n, hits)
    }
    if seedOut != strings.Replace(seed, word, hits[0].Placeholder, 1) {
        t.Fatal("unexpected seed output")
    }

    hits = nil
    after := "Review SSH " + word + " authentication now."
    out, n := Mask(after, o)
    if n != 1 || len(hits) != 1 || hits[0].Kind != "PASSWORD" || hits[0].By != ByKnown {
        t.Fatalf("expected known/password in fresh prose: n=%d hits=%v", n, hits)
    }
    if out != strings.Replace(after, word, hits[0].Placeholder, 1) {
        t.Fatal("unexpected prose output")
    }
}
```

</details>

Codex assisted with the log analysis and reproduction.

**Observation during this investigation:** On 2026-11-02, the first locally observed `rule` record for the existing public example word `verifier` appeared about two seconds after a tool returned this issue's comments into the analysis chat. The same keyed value was subsequently recorded as `known` in two other sessions. The persisted log does not establish the original seed or the surrounding text in those other sessions, so this is a sequence consistent with cross-session propagation, not proof of the exact content affected. These records arose during this investigation and are not independent historical reports.

**Additional historical candidates.** Before this investigation started, the logs also recorded the following values as `SECRET`. I matched each value locally against its keyed placeholder. These strings have ordinary technical uses, but the saved records do not include the text around each match, so these are suspected false positives rather than individually verified instances. A string could also be used as an actual secret in a different context.

| Matched value | Request records | Recorded finder label | Ordinary use |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- |
| `CreateProcessAsUserW` | `894` | `3 rule; 891 known` | `Windows API function name` |
| `WindowStyle Hidden` | `642` | `642 known` | `PowerShell option text` |
| `maxAgeDays` | `288` | `49 model; 239 known` | `configuration-style identifier` |
| `pbkdf2-sha256` | `12` | `12 rule` | `algorithm name` |

The snapshot ends at 2026-11-02 16:52 UTC+8, before this investigation; these counts can include repeated conversation history. A request's label is the log's merged label for that value, not necessarily the finder for every position in the request.

timeline.body:
Thank you for the measurement and the clean reproduction — the counts (4,888 request records, 4,560 of them labelled `known`, 29,179 recorded positions) and the three-step repro name the defect exactly, and your caution that they are masking counts rather than verified false positives is the right way to read them.

**The class.** This is the known-value learning (known.go), the same family as `paperclip`/`verifier`, but a different face of it. Those two were a URL password that equals its user name; `hiddenInURL` on current main already leaves those as written. Your case is the other shape a placeholder connection string has: the password is not the user name, so the URL's password slot is masked at mask time — correctly — and then `addKnown` learned the value. The value was the bare word `password`: the credential's own name, the word every example credential is given (`postgresql://example:password@localhost/test`, `DB_PASSWORD=password`). Once learned, every ordinary sentence that uses the word went as `{{PASSWORD_<hash>}}`, which is what your 4,560 `known` records show. I reproduced it on the current main source exactly as your test does.

**The fix** (branch [`fix/3365-known-common-words`](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/3365-known-common-words), head `ad4ee842cfc17a814b6c3f3810437d8172a2842c`, based on today's main): such a word is not learned. `addKnown` turns away a value in a small closed list — `password`, `passphrase`, `username`, `credential`, `credentials` — words that name a credential and appear as stand-in values in example credentials. Everything else is unchanged:

- The URL's own mask still happens on the first request: `postgresql://example:password@localhost/test` masks the userinfo password exactly as before, `rule / PASSWORD`. Only the spreading as `known` stops, so `Review SSH password authentication now.` stays as written afterwards.
- Restore is untouched: the value is held by its placeholder either way.
- Learning still works for real credentials: a password with a digit, symbol or capital in it (`Tr0ub4dor3`) is learned from the same URL slot and re-masked in later prose as before.

**The boundary, stated plainly.** The list is closed and every entry is lowercase letters alone, so deliberately:

- A bare common word *outside* the list still learns — `strawberry` from `postgresql://example:strawberry@…` still replaces later text. `opensesame` already had a test holding that behavior (`TestURLPasswordStillMasked`), and a real password can be any word: a broader dictionary of ordinary words is a real trade-off (it would stop propagating genuine one-word passwords), so I did not make that choice unilaterally. If a dictionary guard is preferred, this is the single place to widen.
- Mixed case (`Password`) and anything with a digit or symbol still learn.
- Your historical candidates table mostly sits outside this guard by shape: `CreateProcessAsUserW` and `maxAgeDays` are mixed case, `WindowStyle Hidden` has a space, `pbkdf2-sha256` has digits and a hyphen. They are the wider question of what the model/rules should learn from technical prose, not this face.

Tests: `TestCredentialOwnNameNotLearned` (adapted from your repro) — URL masks once, later prose and `DB_PASSWORD=password` stay as written, real-password control still re-masks, `strawberry` and `Password` still learn. Red on main with only the `addKnown` check removed; full `internal/redact` package passes (nogui and default tags), gofmt clean, `go vet` clean.
